in_latin.name: Ernaldus
in_latin.meaning: Name of Germanic origin, composed of 'erna' meaning 'noble' and 'wald' meaning 'ruler'
in_latin.long_meaning: Derives from Old High German 'erna' meaning 'noble' and 'wald' meaning 'ruler'. In Latin, 'Ernaldus' was a common name among early Christians, symbolizing nobility and leadership in faith. Historically, it was used in Christian tradition to signify a person of high moral character and strong spiritual convictions.
